CustomField.label: Closed in last 12 months
CustomField.description: SCRUM-464: rolling twelve-month window on ClosedDate (the date the case was closed). The report metadata has no rolling 12-month interval, so the window is this gate plus INTERVAL_CUSTOM (house Lost_Last_12M__c). Cases without ClosedDate are outside the window and are never retro-fixed (PO decision). System-computed, read-only.
